title: Mixture-of-Control: State-Aware Fine-Tuning for Transformer-based Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.31397v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: State-based fine-tuning has emerged as a compelling alternative to weight-based adaptation for transformers, updating lightweight controls into states rather than model weights, offering substantial memory savings while retaining parameter efficiency. However, most existing state-based methods typically apply only per-block control updates, which limits inter-block information exchange and restricts representational adaptation. Meanwhile, prior mechanisms that enable cross-block communication often introduce considerable computational overhead, reducing their practicality for efficient fine-tuning. We introduce Mixture-of-Control (MoC), an efficient cross-layer communication that adaptively integrates local and global control signals to enhance representation learning during adaptation. MoC treats block-wise control states as experts in a sparse mixture-of-experts process, enabling efficient communication across transformer blocks. E

translated_title: 控制混合：面向基于Transformer模型的状态感知微调
translated_abstract: 基于状态的微调已成为Transformer基于权重自适应的一种有吸引力的替代方案，它将轻量级控制更新到状态中而非模型权重中，在保持参数效率的同时提供了显著的内存节省。然而，大多数现有的基于状态的方法通常仅应用逐块的控制更新，这限制了块间的信息交换并制约了表示自适应能力。同时，先前支持跨块通信的机制往往会引入相当大的计算开销，降低了其在高效微调中的实用性。我们提出了控制混合，这是一种高效的跨层通信机制，能够自适应地整合局部和全局控制信号，以增强自适应过程中的表示学习。MoC将逐块控制状态视为稀疏混合专家过程中的专家，从而实现跨Transformer块的高效通信。
tldr: 提出了控制混合方法，将逐块控制状态作为稀疏混合专家中的专家，实现高效的跨块通信，自适应整合局部与全局控制信号，从而在状态感知微调中增强表示学习。
en_tdlr: Mixture-of-Control (MoC) treats block-wise control states as experts in a sparse mixture-of-experts process, enabling efficient cross-block communication that adaptively integrates local and global control signals to enhance representation learning during fine-tuning.
